thread:
cory: morning — saw an uptick in 'unassigned' leads right after the enrichment deploy. SLA alarm fired :alarm_clock:. anyone on routing?
nina: seeing it too. traces show enrich replies coming back after the rr slot expires so they drop to unassigned fallback.
arjun: short-term fix idea: soft-fail into overflow + tag leads as pending_enrich, and do a quick retry (5s) before falling through. keeps SDR cadence intact.
hubspot-bot: metric.alert: inbound.handoff.unassigned_rate=6.2% window=12m source=hs-sync
taylor: agree on pending_enrich tag. also set owner_write_defer=true so we don't stomp SF owner fields when enrich completes later. exclude pending_enrich from outbound sequences for 20m.
cory: canary plan required. arjun: propose 4% canary with router changes; snippet below:
```
router.handoff = {
  softfail_retry_ms: 5000,
  softfail_overflow: true,
  pending_enrich_ttl_s: 120
}
```
nina: add heartbeat metrics: inbound.handoff.softfail_count and delta_unassigned_per_min. tag logs with "softfail.v2" so we can filter.
taylor: I'll add a HubSpot saved view: property=pending_enrich=true and update SDR playbook to skip those leads. also will patch the SF mapping doc to queue owner writes.
cory: owners: arjun=code+canary, nina=telemetry+rollback play, taylor=docs+filters, me=CSM comms. schedule: start canary at 09:40 UTC. rollback triggers: unassigned_rate > baseline*1.5 within 10m OR assignment_latency_p95 > baseline*2.
hubspot-bot: deploy.plan: canary=4% scheduled_by=arjun start=3755550200
arjun: starting canary now, posting periodic deltas.
cory: thanks — short-term patch first, long-term we should build a predictive enrich cache and harden DB replicas + circuit-breaker on enrich calls. if anyone sees new spikes ping @here immediately. :rocket:
